Three magic users are plotting in a tower full of undead in the desert. Climb the {wiki:Triangle Tower} floor by floor, past Skeletons, Ghouls, Demon Skeletons and Stalkers, and open the box at the top to receive a {item:Garlic Necklace}, a {item:Dwarven Ring} and two {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}.
Three magic users are plotting in a tower full of undead.
Optional: {item:Stealth Ring} or the {spell:Invisible} spell to get past the Demon Skeletons
{creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} cannot see invisible enemies: the {spell:Invisible} spell or a {item:Stealth Ring} helps a lot.
The {creature:Dwarf Geomancer} is hard to kill with a sword at low levels/skills. You do not need to kill it.
Go to the {wiki:Triangle Tower}, in the desert. It is **east of Thais** and **south of Kazordoon**, northwest of the Desert Dungeon: leave Thais to the **east** and follow the road to the tower.

If the entrance is closed, go into the desert and pull the lever that opens the wall. The lever is on the other side of the river, hidden under rubble, and the way there is long: check first whether the tower is open.
Climb the tower to the top. On each floor you will find:
1 {creature:Bonelord} (and a teleport out of the tower)
The Demon Skeletons cannot see you if you are invisible.

After you reach the 4th floor and kill everything, go up and open the box to receive the reward. Alternatively, kill only the {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monk} and the {creature:Witch} (they are easy), grab the reward and leave.
The {creature:Dwarf Geomancer} is hard to kill in melee at a low level or with low skills.

Go down to the bottom of the tower and leave. If someone has closed the door, go down to the basement and use the teleport, which takes you outside. Careful: in the basement, next to the teleport, there is a {creature:Bonelord}. Then walk back **west** to Thais.
